name: UI story promo
description: For a software product only: a vertical video told on the product's own screens, animated, with no footage. A hook on a clock, your name and tagline, a request typed into the product's chat, a task board taking the work, a question for you, the work done by morning, what came back, the team behind it, and the end card. 40 s, also cut to 15 s (the hook, the board, the end card) and 30 s (without what came back and the team). Pick it only for a brief about software; for any other business, pick a photo card or the Data story. Its music is "Where the Night Begins" by Sascha Ende (CC BY 4.0) from 190.1 s; the post's copy carries its credit.

hook_eyebrow.label: Hook: the line above the clock
hook_eyebrow.description: Written in capitals above the big clock as the video opens: the day and the business's name, separated by ' · '.

hook_time_before.label: Hook: the clock, first
hook_time_before.description: The big clock as the video opens, as HH:MM: the minute before the moment the headline is about.

hook_time_after.label: Hook: the clock, then
hook_time_after.description: The time the big clock flips to, as HH:MM: the moment the headline is about.

hook_line.label: Hook: the headline
hook_line.description: The large line under the clock, landing word by word as the voice says it. The accent words follow it. Four or five words.

hook_accent.label: Hook: the accent words
hook_accent.description: One short word that ends the headline, in italics in the brand colour, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

problem_line.label: Problem: the line
problem_line.description: The next line, on its own once the screen goes dark: the problem the hook sets up, word by word and spoken. The accent words follow it.

problem_accent.label: Problem: the accent words
problem_accent.description: Words that end the problem line, in italics in the brand colour, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

tagline_lead.label: Reveal: the tagline before its accent
tagline_lead.description: Under the logo and the brand's name in the reveal, word by word, and spoken. The tagline reads this part, the accent word, then the rest.

tagline_accent.label: Reveal: the tagline's accent word
tagline_accent.description: One word of the tagline in italics in the brand colour, between its two parts, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

tagline_tail.label: Reveal: the tagline after its accent
tagline_tail.description: The end of the tagline, after the accent word, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

chat_crumb.label: Chat: the page name at the top
chat_crumb.description: Small text at the top left of the product's chat screen, before the conversation's title, like a folder name.

chat_title.label: Chat: the conversation's title
chat_title.description: At the top of the chat screen, after the page name, in brighter text: what this conversation is about, in a few words.

chat_counter_label.label: Chat: the counter's word
chat_counter_label.description: A short word in capitals in the pill at the top right of the chat screen, before its number.

chat_counter.label: Chat: the counter's number
chat_counter.description: The number in the pill at the top right of the chat screen, such as how many conversations are open. Digits only.

chat_greeting.label: Chat: the assistant's greeting
chat_greeting.description: The product's greeting at the top of the chat, in large type, shown before the request is typed. One short sentence.

chat_request.label: Chat: the request
chat_request.description: What the person asks the product for: typed into the message box, then sent as their message. One sentence.

chat_thinking.label: Chat: the thinking word
chat_thinking.description: Shown with three moving dots in the product's reply while it works out its answer.

chat_reply.label: Chat: the assistant's reply
chat_reply.description: The first line of the product's reply, above the three steps it takes.

step_1_label.label: Chat: reply step 1
step_1_label.description: The first step listed in the reply: what the product does first. Its detail and its time follow on the same row.

step_1_detail.label: Chat: reply step 1's detail
step_1_detail.description: What step 1 works on, after its name, starting with '· ', such as a count of notes or a document's name.

step_1_time.label: Chat: reply step 1's time
step_1_time.description: How long step 1 took, at the end of its row, in seconds with an 's'.

step_2_label.label: Chat: reply step 2
step_2_label.description: The second step listed in the reply: what the product does next.

step_2_detail.label: Chat: reply step 2's detail
step_2_detail.description: What step 2 works on, after its name, starting with '· ', such as the document it checks.

step_2_time.label: Chat: reply step 2's time
step_2_time.description: How long step 2 took, at the end of its row, in seconds with an 's'.

step_3_label.label: Chat: reply step 3
step_3_label.description: The third step listed in the reply: what the product does last.

step_3_detail.label: Chat: reply step 3's detail
step_3_detail.description: What step 3 works on, after its name, starting with '· ', such as how many tasks it sets up for the board.

step_3_time.label: Chat: reply step 3's time
step_3_time.description: How long step 3 took, at the end of its row, in seconds with an 's'.

route_label.label: Chat: where the work went
route_label.description: The last line of the reply: who the work went to and how sure the product is, written as 'Routed to:', a name in capitals and a percentage.

chat_placeholder.label: Chat: the message box's hint
chat_placeholder.description: The hint in the empty message box at the foot of the chat screen, before the request is typed.

board_eyebrow.label: Board: the line above the title
board_eyebrow.description: Small text at the top of the task board: the team or workspace, the day and date, the time and the city, separated by ' · '.

board_title.label: Board: the title
board_title.description: The task board's large title, under the line above it.

board_working_label.label: Board: counter 1's label
board_working_label.description: The word over the board's first counter, which counts up as each task starts.

board_agents_label.label: Board: counter 2's label
board_agents_label.description: The word over the board's second counter, whose number is set below.

board_agents.label: Board: counter 2's number
board_agents.description: The number under counter 2's label, such as how many people work the board. Digits only.

board_queue_label.label: Board: counter 3's label
board_queue_label.description: The word over the board's third counter, which counts down as each task starts.

board_attention_label.label: Board: counter 4's label
board_attention_label.description: The word over the board's fourth counter, which goes from 0 to 1 when the question card comes up.

board_column_1.label: Board: column 1's name
board_column_1.description: The heading of the board's first column, where the four tasks start.

board_column_2.label: Board: column 2's name
board_column_2.description: The heading of the board's second column, where each task moves as the voice names it.

board_column_3.label: Board: column 3's name
board_column_3.description: The heading of the board's third column, where task 1 lands when it is finished.

task_1_kind.label: Board: task 1's type
task_1_kind.description: A short word in capitals at the top of task 1's card, before its flag.

task_1_flag.label: Board: task 1's flag
task_1_flag.description: A short mark after task 1's type, starting with '· ', such as a priority. Leave empty for none.

task_1_title.label: Board: task 1's title
task_1_title.description: What task 1 is, on its card. It moves to In Progress as the voice says the word for task 1, then lands in Done.

task_1_agent.label: Board: who takes task 1
task_1_agent.description: The name on task 1's card once it is taken, in place of the not-yet-taken label: a person, a team or a tool.

task_2_kind.label: Board: task 2's type
task_2_kind.description: A short word in capitals at the top of task 2's card, before its flag.

task_2_flag.label: Board: task 2's flag
task_2_flag.description: A short mark after task 2's type, starting with '· ', such as a priority. Leave empty for none.

task_2_title.label: Board: task 2's title
task_2_title.description: What task 2 is, on its card. It moves to In Progress as the voice says the word for task 2.

task_2_agent.label: Board: who takes task 2
task_2_agent.description: The name on task 2's card once it is taken, in place of the not-yet-taken label: a person, a team or a tool.

task_3_kind.label: Board: task 3's type
task_3_kind.description: A short word in capitals at the top of task 3's card, before its flag.

task_3_flag.label: Board: task 3's flag
task_3_flag.description: A short mark after task 3's type, starting with '· ', such as a priority. Leave empty for none.

task_3_title.label: Board: task 3's title
task_3_title.description: What task 3 is, on its card. It moves to In Progress as the voice says the word for task 3.

task_3_agent.label: Board: who takes task 3
task_3_agent.description: The name on task 3's card once it is taken, in place of the not-yet-taken label: a person, a team or a tool.

task_4_kind.label: Board: task 4's type
task_4_kind.description: A short word in capitals at the top of task 4's card, before its flag.

task_4_flag.label: Board: task 4's flag
task_4_flag.description: A short mark after task 4's type, starting with '· ', such as a priority. Leave empty for none.

task_4_title.label: Board: task 4's title
task_4_title.description: What task 4 is, on its card. It moves to In Progress as the voice says the word for task 4.

task_4_agent.label: Board: who takes task 4
task_4_agent.description: The name on task 4's card once it is taken, in place of the not-yet-taken label: a person, a team or a tool.

task_unassigned.label: Board: the not-yet-taken label
task_unassigned.description: Shown on every task card before someone takes it, then replaced by the name of who takes it.

ask_meta.label: Question card: who asks
ask_meta.description: Small text at the top of the question card, which comes up over the board: who raises the question, such as a name and a reference.

ask_badge.label: Question card: the badge
ask_badge.description: A small badge at the top right of the question card.

ask_question.label: Question card: the question
ask_question.description: The question put to the owner, in large type: a decision only they can make. One sentence.

ask_block_title.label: Question card: the box's title
ask_block_title.description: Written in capitals over the box under the question: what the question holds up, or what it is about.

ask_block_line_1.label: Question card: box line 1
ask_block_line_1.description: The first line in the box under the question, starting with '↳ ': something the question holds up, or what someone said.

ask_block_line_2.label: Question card: box line 2
ask_block_line_2.description: The second line in the box under the question, starting with '↳ '.

ask_option_a.label: Question card: the answer picked
ask_option_a.description: The first answer button. It is tapped and lights up, so it is the owner's choice.

ask_option_b.label: Question card: the other answer
ask_option_b.description: The second answer button, the one not picked.

ask_own_words.label: Question card: the write-your-own link
ask_own_words.description: A small link under the two answers, for answering in one's own words.
ask_own_words.default: Answer in your own words instead

ask_toast.label: Question card: the confirmation
ask_toast.description: The note that pops up once the answer is picked.

night_date.label: Morning: the night's date line
night_date.description: Written in capitals above the big clock: the evening the work starts, as the day, the date and the city, separated by ' · '.

morning_date.label: Morning: the morning's date line
morning_date.description: Takes the night's place as the clock rolls on: the next morning, written the same way as the night's date line.

night_hour.label: Morning: the night's hour
night_hour.description: The hour the big clock starts at, 0 to 23. The hours roll from it to the morning's hour.

night_minute.label: Morning: the night's minutes
night_minute.description: The minutes the big clock starts at, two digits.

morning_hour.label: Morning: the morning's hour
morning_hour.description: The hour the big clock stops at, 0 to 23.

morning_minute.label: Morning: the morning's minutes
morning_minute.description: The minutes the big clock stops at, two digits.

done_1.label: Morning: done item 1
done_1.description: The first of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

done_2.label: Morning: done item 2
done_2.description: The second of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

done_3.label: Morning: done item 3
done_3.description: The third of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

done_4.label: Morning: done item 4
done_4.description: The fourth of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

done_5.label: Morning: done item 5
done_5.description: The fifth of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

done_6.label: Morning: done item 6
done_6.description: The last of six things finished by morning, ticked off under the clock. A few words.

outputs_eyebrow.label: Results: the line above the title
outputs_eyebrow.description: Small text at the top of the screen of what came back, over its title.

outputs_title.label: Results: the title
outputs_title.description: The large title of the screen of what came back.

outputs_lead.label: Results: the words before the count
outputs_lead.description: The start of the line under the title, before the count, such as who made the work.

outputs_count.label: Results: the count
outputs_count.description: In the brand colour mid-line: how much was made, as a number and a word. A fact, so it needs its source; without one, leave it empty and write the words around it as one line.

outputs_tail.label: Results: the words after the count
outputs_tail.description: The end of the line, after the count, such as when the work was made.

outputs_pill_1.label: Results: filter tab 1
outputs_pill_1.description: The first of four filter tabs under the line, shown as the selected one.

outputs_pill_2.label: Results: filter tab 2
outputs_pill_2.description: The second of four filter tabs under the line.

outputs_pill_3.label: Results: filter tab 3
outputs_pill_3.description: The third of four filter tabs under the line.

outputs_pill_4.label: Results: filter tab 4
outputs_pill_4.description: The last of four filter tabs under the line.

output_1_agent.label: Results: who made card 1
output_1_agent.description: Small text at the top of result card 1: the person, team or tool that made it.

output_1_kind.label: Results: card 1's type
output_1_kind.description: A tag at the top right of result card 1: what kind of work it is, in one word.

output_1_title.label: Results: card 1's title
output_1_title.description: The title of result card 1, under its preview: the piece of work itself.

output_2_agent.label: Results: who made card 2
output_2_agent.description: Small text at the top of result card 2: the person, team or tool that made it.

output_2_kind.label: Results: card 2's type
output_2_kind.description: A tag at the top right of result card 2: what kind of work it is, in one word.

output_2_title.label: Results: card 2's title
output_2_title.description: The title of result card 2, under its preview: the piece of work itself.

output_3_agent.label: Results: who made card 3
output_3_agent.description: Small text at the top of result card 3: the person, team or tool that made it.

output_3_kind.label: Results: card 3's type
output_3_kind.description: A tag at the top right of result card 3: what kind of work it is, in one word.

output_3_title.label: Results: card 3's title
output_3_title.description: The title of result card 3, under its preview: the piece of work itself.

output_4_agent.label: Results: who made card 4
output_4_agent.description: Small text at the top of result card 4: the person, team or tool that made it.

output_4_kind.label: Results: card 4's type
output_4_kind.description: A tag at the top right of result card 4: what kind of work it is, in one word.

output_4_title.label: Results: card 4's title
output_4_title.description: The title of result card 4, under its preview: the piece of work itself.

team_line_1.label: Team: the line about the team
team_line_1.description: The first line of the team screen, large, and spoken: what the team does with the product.

team_line_2.label: Team: line 2
team_line_2.description: A second line under the first, spoken after it. Leave empty for none.

team_line_2_accent.label: Team: line 2's accent
team_line_2_accent.description: Words in italics in the brand colour at the end of line 2, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

team_line_3.label: Team: line 3
team_line_3.description: A third line under the second, spoken after it. Leave empty for none.

team_line_3_accent.label: Team: line 3's accent
team_line_3_accent.description: Words in italics in the brand colour at the end of line 3, spoken with it. Leave empty for none.

team_roster.label: Team: the names
team_roster.description: The names on the cards under the team's lines: up to nine people, teams or tools, separated by commas. Each card shows a status beside its name.

team_idle.label: Team: the status before
team_idle.description: The word each name card shows first, before the team gets to work.

team_busy.label: Team: the status after
team_busy.description: The word each name card switches to when the team gets to work.

end_line.label: End card: line 1
end_line.description: Large, under the logo and the brand's name on the end card, and spoken after the name.

end_accent.label: End card: line 2
end_accent.description: In italics in the brand colour under line 1, spoken after it. Together the two lines close the video.

end_url.label: End card: the web address
end_url.description: Under the two lines on the end card, written without https://.

end_note.label: End card: the small print
end_note.description: Small text in capitals under the web address, such as where to find the link. Leave empty for none.

cap_ask.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption as the chat screen opens. A few words.

cap_handoff.label: Board: the voice line
cap_handoff.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption as the task board comes up. A few words; the words for tasks 1 to 4 follow it.

beat_1.label: Board: the word for task 1
beat_1.description: Said by the voice and lit in the caption as task 1 moves to In Progress: a word or two naming task 1's work.

beat_2.label: Board: the word for task 2
beat_2.description: Said by the voice and lit in the caption as task 2 moves to In Progress: a word or two naming task 2's work.

beat_3.label: Board: the word for task 3

beat_4.description: Said by the voice and lit in the caption as task 4 moves to In Progress: a word or two naming task 4's work.

cap_question.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption as the question card comes up. One short sentence.

cap_morning.label: Morning: the voice line
cap_morning.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption over the big clock and the list of work done. One short sentence.

cap_outputs.label: Results: the voice line
cap_outputs.description: Said by the voice and shown as the caption over the screen of what came back. One short sentence.
